params.description: The number of coupon payments per year. For annual payments, frequency = 1; for semiannual, frequency = 2; for quarterly, frequency = 4.

params.name: [basis]
params.description: Optional. The type of day count basis to use.

params.name: [calc_method]
params.description: Optional. Not implemented in formulajs. A value of TRUE (1) returns the total accrued interest from issue to settlement. A value of FALSE (0) returns the accrued interest from first_interest to settlement. If you do not enter the argument, it defaults to TRUE.

signature: ACCRINT(issue, first_interest, settlement, rate, par, frequency, [basis], [calc_method])

name: FV

params.name: rate
params.description: The interest rate per period.

params.name: nper
params.description: The total number of payment periods in an annuity.

params.description: Optional. The present value, or the lump-sum amount that a series of future payments is worth right now. If pv is omitted, it is assumed to be 0 (zero), and you must include the pmt argument.

params.name: [type]
params.description: Optional. The number 0 or 1 and indicates when payments are due. If type is omitted, it is assumed to be 0.

name: GEOMEAN

title: GROWTH

params.name: known_y
params.description: The set of y-values you already know in the relationship y = b*m^x.

params.name: [known_x]
params.description: Optional. An optional set of x-values that you may already know in the relationship y = b*m^x.

params.name: [new_x]
params.description: Optional. Are new x-values for which you want GROWTH to return corresponding y-values.

params.name: [use_const]
params.description: Optional. A logical value specifying whether to force the constant b to equal 1. If const is TRUE or omitted, b is calculated normally. If const is FALSE, b is set equal to 1 and the m-values are adjusted so that y = m^x.

name: HEX2BIN
title: HEX2BIN
description: Converts a hexadecimal number to binary.

params.name: number
params.description: The hexadecimal number you want to convert. Number cannot contain more than 10 characters. The most significant bit of number is the sign bit (40th bit from the right). The remaining 9 bits are magnitude bits. Negative numbers are represented using two's-complement notation.

params.name: [places]
params.description: Optional. The number of characters to use. If places is omitted, HEX2BIN uses the minimum number of characters necessary. Places is useful for padding the return value with leading 0s (zeros).

name: HLOOKUP
title: بحث أفقي
ar: يبحث في أول صف ويعيد قيمة من صف آخر. FALSE للمطابقة التامة.
description: Looks in the top row of an array and returns the value of the indicated value.

params.name: lookup_value
params.description: The value to be found in the first row of the table. Lookup_value can be a value, a reference, or a text string.

params.name: table_array
params.description: A table of information in which data is looked up. Use a reference to a range or a range name.

params.name: row_index_num
params.description: The row number in table_array from which the matching value will be returned. A row_index_num of 1 returns the first row value in table_array, a row_index_num of 2 returns the second row value in table_array, and so on. If row_index_num is less than 1, HLOOKUP returns the #VALUE! error value; if row_index_num is greater than the number of rows on table_array, HLOOKUP returns the #REF! error value.

params.name: [range_lookup]
params.description: Optional. A logical value that specifies whether you want HLOOKUP to find an exact match or an approximate match. If TRUE or omitted, an approximate match is returned. In other words, if an exact match is not found, the next largest value that is less than lookup_value is returned. If FALSE, HLOOKUP will find an exact match. If one is not found, the error value #N/A is returned.

params.description: The payment made each period; it cannot change over the life of the annuity. Typically, pmt contains principal and interest but no other fees or taxes.

title: PRICEDISC

params.description: The security's settlement date. The security settlement date is the date after the issue date when the security is traded to the buyer.

params.name: maturity
params.description: The security's maturity date. The maturity date is the date when the security expires.

params.name: discount
params.description: The security's discount rate.

params.name: redemption
params.description: The security's redemption value per $100 face value.

params.name: [basis]
params.description: Optional. The type of day count basis to use.

name: PROB

params.name: x_range
params.description: The range of numeric values of x with which there are associated probabilities.

params.name: prob_range
params.description: A set of probabilities associated with values in x_range.

params.name: [lower_limit]
params.description: Optional. The lower bound on the value for which you want a probability.

params.name: [upper_limit]
params.description: Optional. The optional upper bound on the value for which you want a probability.

name: PRODUCT
title: ضرب مجموعة أرقام

description: Multiplies its arguments.

params.name: args
params.description: number2, ... Optional. Additional numbers or ranges that you want to multiply, up to a maximum of 255 arguments.

name: PROPER
title: بداية الكلمة كبيرة
ar: يحوّل أول حرف لاتيني من كل كلمة إلى كبير.
description: Capitalizes the first letter in each word of a text value.

params.name: text
params.description: Text enclosed in quotation marks, a formula that returns text, or a reference to a value containing the text you want to partially capitalize.

name: PV
title: القيمة الحالية
ar: يحسب قيمة التدفقات المستقبلية بمعدل خصم ثابت لكل فترة.
description: Returns the present value of an investment.

params.name: rate
params.description: The interest rate per period. For example, if you obtain an automobile loan at a 10 percent annual interest rate and make monthly payments, your interest rate per month is 10%/12, or 0.83%. You would enter 10%/12, or 0.83%, or 0.0083, into the formula as the rate.

params.name: nper
params.description: The total number of payment periods in an annuity. For example, if you get a four-year car loan and make monthly payments, your loan has 4*12 (or 48) periods. You would enter 48 into the formula for nper.

params.name: pmt
params.description: The payment made each period and cannot change over the life of the annuity. Typically, pmt includes principal and interest but no other fees or taxes. For example, the monthly payments on a $10,000, four-year car loan at 12 percent are $263.33. You would enter -263.33 into the formula as the pmt. If pmt is omitted, you must include the fv argument.

params.name: [fv]
params.description: Optional. The future value, or a cash balance you want to attain after the last payment is made. If fv is omitted, it is assumed to be 0 (the future value of a loan, for example, is 0). For example, if you want to save $50,000 to pay for a special project in 18 years, then $50,000 is the future value. You could then make a conservative guess at an interest rate and determine how much you must save each month. If fv is omitted, you must include the pmt argument.

params.name: [type]
params.description: Optional. The number 0 or 1 and indicates when payments are due.

name: QUARTILE.EXC
title: QUARTILE.EXC
description: Returns the quartile of the data set, based on percentile values from 0..1, exclusive.

params.name: array

params.name: quart
params.description: Indicates which value to return.

name: QUARTILE.INC

params.name: array

params.name: quart

name: QUOTIENT

name: RAND
title: RAND

name: RANDBETWEEN
title: رقم عشوائي صحيح
ar: يعيد رقمًا عشوائيًا صحيحًا بين حدين، ويتغير عند إعادة الحساب.
description: Returns a random number between the numbers you specify.

params.name: bottom

params.name: top
params.description: The largest integer RANDBETWEEN will return.

name: RANK.AVG
title: RANK.AVG
description: Returns the rank of a number in a list of numbers.

params.description: The number whose rank you want to find.

params.name: ref
params.description: An array of, or a reference to, a list of numbers. Nonnumeric values in Ref are ignored.

name: RANK.EQ
title: RANK.EQ

params.name: ref
params.description: An array of, or a reference to, a list of numbers. Non-numeric values in Ref are ignored.

params.name: [order]
params.description: Optional. A number specifying how to rank number.

name: RATE
title: RATE
description: Returns the interest rate per period of an annuity.

params.name: nper
params.description: The total number of payment periods in an annuity.

params.name: pmt
params.description: The payment made each period and cannot change over the life of the annuity. Typically, pmt includes principal and interest but no other fees or taxes. If pmt is omitted, you must include the fv argument.

params.name: pv
params.description: The present value — the total amount that a series of future payments is worth now.

params.name: [fv]
params.description: Optional. The future value, or a cash balance you want to attain after the last payment is made. If fv is omitted, it is assumed to be 0 (the future value of a loan, for example, is 0). If fv is omitted, you must include the pmt argument.

params.name: [type]
params.description: Optional. The number 0 or 1 and indicates when payments are due.

params.name: [guess]
params.description: Optional. Your guess for what the rate will be. If you omit guess, it is assumed to be 10 percent. If RATE does not converge, try different values for guess. RATE usually converges if guess is between 0 and 1.

name: REPLACE
title: استبدال حسب الموضع
ar: يستبدل عددًا من الحروف بداية من موقع محدد.
description: Replaces characters within text

params.name: old_text
params.description: Text in which you want to replace some characters.

params.description: The number of characters in old_text that you want REPLACE to replace with new_text.

name: REPLACEB

params.description: A positive number specifying the number of times to repeat text.

name: RIGHT

params.name: text

params.name: [num_chars]

params.name: number
params.description: The number that you want to round.

params.name: num_digits

name: ROUNDDOWN
title: تقريب باتجاه الصفر
ar: يحذف المنازل الزائدة باتجاه الصفر.
description: Rounds a number down, toward zero.

params.name: number
params.description: Any real number that you want rounded down.

params.name: num_digits
params.description: The number of digits to which you want to round number.

name: ROUNDUP
title: تقريب بعيدًا عن الصفر
ar: يقرب بعيدًا عن الصفر إلى عدد المنازل المحدد.
description: Rounds a number up, away from zero.

params.name: number
params.description: Any real number that you want rounded up.

params.name: num_digits
params.description: The number of digits to which you want to round number.

name: ROW

title: البحث داخل نص
ar: يبحث عن الموضع دون التمييز بين الحروف اللاتينية الكبيرة والصغيرة.
description: Finds one text value within another (not case-sensitive)

title: SEC

title: SECH

params.description: The angle in radians for which you want the hyperbolic secant.

name: SECOND
title: SECOND
description: Converts a serial number to a second.

params.name: serial_number
params.description: The time that contains the seconds you want to find. Times may be entered as text strings within quotation marks (for example, "6:45 PM"), as decimal numbers (for example, 0.78125, which represents 6:45 PM), or as results of other formulas or functions (for example, TIMEVALUE("6:45 PM")).

name: SERIESSUM
title: SERIESSUM
description: Returns the sum of a power series based on the formula.

params.name: x
params.description: The input value to the power series.

params.name: n
params.description: The initial power to which you want to raise x.

params.name: m
params.description: The step by which to increase n for each term in the series.

params.name: coefficients
params.description: A set of coefficients by which each successive power of x is multiplied. The number of values in coefficients determines the number of terms in the power series. For example, if there are three values in coefficients, then there will be three terms in the power series.

name: SIGN
title: SIGN

title: SKEW

params.description: An array or range of numerical data for which you want to determine the k-th smallest value.

params.description: The position (from the smallest) in the array or range of data to return.

name: SORT

params.description: Optional. A number indicating the row or column to sort by

params.name: [sort_order]
params.description: Optional. A number indicating the desired sort order; 1 for ascending order (default), -1 for descending order

params.name: [by_col]
params.description: Optional. A logical value indicating the desired sort direction; FALSE to sort by row (default), TRUE to sort by column

name: SQRT
title: الجذر التربيعي
ar: يعيد الجذر التربيعي لرقم غير سالب.

params.name: number

params.name: mean

params.name: standard_dev

title: STDEV.P
description: Calculates standard deviation based on the entire population.

params.name: args

name: STDEV.S
title: STDEV.S

params.name: args

name: STDEVP

params.name: args

name: SUBSTITUTE
title: استبدال نص
ar: يستبدل نصًا محددًا بنص آخر، ويمكن تحديد ترتيب الظهور.
description: Substitutes new text for old text in a text string.

params.name: text
params.description: The text or the reference to a value containing text for which you want to substitute characters.

params.description: The text you want to replace.

params.name: function_num
params.description: The number 1-11 or 101-111 that specifies the function to use for the subtotal. 1-11 includes manually-hidden rows, while 101-111 excludes them; filtered-out values are always excluded.

params.name: range
params.description: The range of values that you want evaluated by criteria. Cells in each range must be numbers or names, arrays, or references that contain numbers. Blank and text values are ignored.

params.name: criteria
params.description: The criteria in the form of a number, expression, a value reference, text, or a function that defines which values will be added.

params.name: [sum_range]
params.description: Optional. The actual values to add, if you want to add values other than those specified in the range argument. If the sum_range argument is omitted, Excel adds the values that are specified in the range argument (the same values to which the criteria is applied). If it isn't, performance may suffer, and the formula will sum a range of values that starts with the first value in sum_range but has the same dimensions as range.

name: TEXT
title: تحويل رقم لنص منسق
ar: يحوّل الرقم لنص بقالب تنسيق Excel، فيصبح الناتج نصًا وليس رقمًا.
description: Formats a number and converts it to text.

params.name: value
params.description: A numeric value that you want to be converted into text.

params.name: format_text
params.description: A text string that defines the formatting that you want to be applied to the supplied value.

name: TEXTJOIN
title: دمج بفاصل
ar: يربط النصوص باستخدام فاصل مع إمكانية تجاهل الفراغات.
description: Combines the text from multiple ranges and/or strings.

params.name: delimiter
params.description: A text string, either empty, or one or more characters enclosed by double quotes, or a reference to a valid text string. If a number is supplied, it will be treated as text.

params.name: ignore_empty
params.description: If TRUE, ignores empty values.

params.name: args
params.description: Text item to be joined. A text string, or array of strings, such as a range of values.

name: TIME
title: TIME
description: Returns the serial number of a particular time.

params.name: hour
params.description: A number from 0 (zero) to 32767 representing the hour. Any value greater than 23 will be divided by 24 and the remainder will be treated as the hour value. For example, TIME(27,0,0) = TIME(3,0,0) = .125 or 3:00 AM.

params.name: minute
params.description: A number from 0 to 32767 representing the minute. Any value greater than 59 will be converted to hours and minutes. For example, TIME(0,750,0) = TIME(12,30,0) = .520833 or 12:30 PM.

params.name: second
params.description: A number from 0 to 32767 representing the second. Any value greater than 59 will be converted to hours, minutes, and seconds. For example, TIME(0,0,2000) = TIME(0,33,22) = .023148 or 12:33:20 AM

name: TIMEVALUE
title: TIMEVALUE
description: Converts a time in the form of text to a serial number.

params.name: time_text
params.description: A text string that represents a time in any one of the Microsoft Excel time formats; for example, "6:45 PM" and "18:45" text strings within quotation marks that represent time.

name: TINV
title: TINV

params.name: probability

params.name: deg_freedom

name: TODAY

description: Returns the serial number of today's date.

name: TRANSPOSE
title: TRANSPOSE
description: Returns the transpose of an array.

params.name: array
params.description: An array or range of values on a worksheet that you want to transpose. The transpose of an array is created by using the first row of the array as the first column of the new array, the second row of the array as the second column of the new array, and so on. If you're not sure of how to enter an array formula, see Create an array formula.

name: TREND

params.name: known_xs

params.name: [new_xs]
params.description: Optional. New x-values for which you want TREND to return corresponding y-values.

name: TRIM
title: تنظيف المسافات

params.name: text

name: TRIMMEAN
title: TRIMMEAN

params.name: array
params.description: The array or range of values to trim and average.

params.name: percent
params.description: The fractional number of data points to exclude from the calculation. For example, if percent = 0.2, 4 points are trimmed from a data set of 20 points (20 x 0.2): 2 from the top and 2 from the bottom of the set.

name: TRUE
title: TRUE

name: TRUNC
title: TRUNC

params.name: number

params.name: [num_digits]

params.name: array1

name: TYPE

name: UNICHAR

params.name: number

name: UNICODE
title: UNICODE

params.name: text

name: UNIQUE

name: UPPER
title: حروف إنجليزية كبيرة
ar: يحوّل الحروف اللاتينية إلى الشكل الكبير. العربية لا تتغير.
description: Converts text to uppercase.

params.name: text

name: VALUE

description: Converts a text argument to a number.

params.name: text

name: VARP

name: VARPA
title: VARPA

params.name: args

name: VLOOKUP
title: بحث رأسي
ar: يبحث في أول عمود من النطاق ويعيد قيمة من عمود آخر. FALSE للمطابقة التامة.
description: Looks in the first column of an array and moves across the row to return the value of a value.

params.name: lookup_value
params.description: The value to be found in the first row of the table. Lookup_value can be a value, a reference, or a text string.

params.name: table_array
params.description: A table of information in which data is looked up. Use a reference to a range or a range name.

params.name: col_index_num
params.description: The row number in table_array from which the matching value will be returned. A row_index_num of 1 returns the first row value in table_array, a row_index_num of 2 returns the second row value in table_array, and so on. If row_index_num is less than 1, HLOOKUP returns the #VALUE! error value; if row_index_num is greater than the number of rows on table_array, HLOOKUP returns the #REF! error value.

params.name: [range_lookup]
params.description: Optional. A logical value that specifies whether you want HLOOKUP to find an exact match or an approximate match. If TRUE or omitted, an approximate match is returned. In other words, if an exact match is not found, the next largest value that is less than lookup_value is returned. If FALSE, HLOOKUP will find an exact match. If one is not found, the error value #N/A is returned.

name: WORKDAY
title: WORKDAY
description: Returns the serial number of the date before or after a specified number of workdays.

params.name: start_date
params.description: A date that represents the start date.

params.name: days
params.description: The number of nonweekend and nonholiday days before or after start_date. A positive value for days yields a future date; a negative value yields a past date.

params.name: [holidays]
params.description: Optional. An optional list of one or more dates to exclude from the working calendar, such as state and federal holidays and floating holidays. The list can be either a range of values that contain the dates or an array constant of the serial numbers that represent the dates.

name: WORKDAY.INTL
title: WORKDAY.INTL
description: Returns the serial number of the date before or after a specified number of workdays using parameters to indicate which and how many days are weekend days.

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date, truncated to integer.

params.name: days
params.description: The number of workdays before or after the start_date. A positive value yields a future date; a negative value yields a past date; a zero value yields the start_date. Day-offset is truncated to an integer.

params.name: [weekend]
params.description: Optional. Indicates the days of the week that are weekend days and are not considered working days. Weekend is a weekend number or string that specifies when weekends occur. Weekend number values indicate the following weekend days:

params.name: [holidays]
params.description: Optional. An optional set of one or more dates that are to be excluded from the working day calendar. Holidays shall be a range of values that contain the dates, or an array constant of the serial values that represent those dates. The ordering of dates or serial values in holidays can be arbitrary.

name: XIRR
title: XIRR
description: Returns the internal rate of return for a schedule of cash flows that is not necessarily periodic.

params.name: values
params.description: A series of cash flows that corresponds to a schedule of payments in dates. The first payment is optional and corresponds to a cost or payment that occurs at the beginning of the investment. If the first value is a cost or payment, it must be a negative value. All succeeding payments are discounted based on a 365-day year. The series of values must contain at least one positive and one negative value.

params.name: dates
params.description: A schedule of payment dates that corresponds to the cash flow payments. Dates may occur in any order. Dates should be entered by using the DATE function, or as results of other formulas or functions. For example, use DATE(2008,5,23) for the 23rd day of May, 2008. Problems can occur if dates are entered as text. .

params.name: [guess]
params.description: Optional. A number that you guess is close to the result of XIRR.

name: XNPV
title: XNPV
description: Returns the net present value for a schedule of cash flows that is not necessarily periodic.

params.name: rate
params.description: The discount rate to apply to the cash flows.

params.name: values
params.description: A series of cash flows that corresponds to a schedule of payments in dates. The first payment is optional and corresponds to a cost or payment that occurs at the beginning of the investment. If the first value is a cost or payment, it must be a negative value. All succeeding payments are discounted based on a 365-day year. The series of values must contain at least one positive value and one negative value.

params.name: dates
params.description: A schedule of payment dates that corresponds to the cash flow payments. The first payment date indicates the beginning of the schedule of payments. All other dates must be later than this date, but they may occur in any order.

params.name: [basis]
params.description: Optional. The type of day count basis to use.
